summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of LendSprint AI. 12/12 pytest backend tests passed. All 14 UI flows (login, seed idempotency, stat cards, filters, new application with PDF/non-PDF validation, full decision flow on BluePeak, memo copy, audit trail, refresh persistence, decided badge, not-found route, duplicate run-decision prevention) passed. BluePeak deterministic decision confirmed (approve, PD 21.4%). Memo ~145 words. Only issue found is a minor React console warning from Login.js due to navigate() being called during render.

ui_bugs.issue: `if (user) navigate('/dashboard', { replace: true })` is called during render, causing React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)'. Should be moved to a useEffect.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Wrap the `if (user) navigate(...)` in Login.js inside a useEffect to eliminate the React setState-in-render warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses `@app.on_event('startup')` which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers.
generate_ai_memo hardcodes model 'openai/gpt-5.4' which will fail if MOCK_MODE ever flipped off with current EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. Not exercised in MOCK_MODE (spec).
server.py is 620 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, applications, documents, decisions, demo) for maintainability, but acceptable for MVP.
Login.js: `if (user) navigate(...)` runs during render — should be useEffect (see UI bug above).
seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/demo/seed (idempotent) to load 3 sample applications. One TEST_QA app was created during the flow test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All spec features verified end-to-end. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, seed idempotency, dashboard stats, list filters, full application lifecycle (create->upload PDF->decision), non-PDF rejection, decision-without-docs 400, known-borrower deterministic PD, and 404 for missing app. UI test covered all data-testids from the review request. Only remaining nit is a Login.js React warning about navigate() during render.
